question: Which Linux companion app track should OpenClaw sponsor as the in-repo direction, and what security/packaging bar must it clear before this umbrella can close?
rationale: Current main has shipped Windows Hub but no Linux companion app, and the active Linux PRs make different architecture and supply-chain choices that automation cannot safely choose for maintainers.

options.title: Keep umbrella and choose a Linux track
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers select one Linux implementation path, require security/packaging proof, and close or redirect competing tracks.

options.title: Split Linux into a narrower canonical issue
options.body: Create or designate a focused Linux companion app issue and close this umbrella only after linking that canonical item and preserving the Windows Hub evidence.

options.title: Move Linux app work outside core
options.body: Treat Linux companion work as an external app/plugin ecosystem effort, which would conflict with VISION.md's explicit companion-app priority unless maintainers change direction.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and choose a Linux track
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers select one Linux implementation path, require security/packaging proof, and close or redirect competing tracks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the umbrella and provided the clearest product-direction comments on the preferred Linux app shape.
